name: The Mentalist
description: Patrick Jane, a former celebrity psychic medium, uses his razor sharp skills of observation and expertise at "reading" people to solve serious crimes with the California Bureau of Investigation.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: CBI consultant Patrick Jane, Senior Agent Teresa Lisbon and her team investigate the double murder in Palm Springs of a pro golfer's wife and her doctor, which has the hallmarks of a serial killer with a personal connection to Jane.

videos.title: Red Hair and Silver Tape
videos.overview: While Lisbon and her team investigate the murder of a young waitress in the Napa Valley, Jane goes behind Lisbon's back to orchestrate his own undercover operation using Van Pelt as bait.

videos.title: Red Tide
videos.overview: When a high school girl's body washes up on the beach, Patrick Jane sets a mentalist trap in order to get her surfing friends to turn on each other and reveal what really happened.

videos.title: Ladies in Red
videos.overview: When the team learns that a wealthy investment banker found murdered inside his locked safe room was living a dual life and skimming millions from clients, Patrick Jane sets up a mental conundrum to see which of the suspects will show their true colors.

videos.title: Redwood
videos.overview: When a girl is found covered in blood and holding the murder weapon that killed her best friend, she becomes an obvious suspect, though she can't remember anything. But Jane, believing she's innocent, engineers a risky maneuver in which she must relive the terrifying events in order to spark her memory.

videos.title: Red Handed
videos.overview: While investigating the case of a murdered casino owner, Patrick Jane uses his mentalist skills to ultimately entrap the killer, and win big at the card tables.

videos.title: Seeing Red
videos.overview: Patrick Jane goes head-to-head with a "psychic" he suspects of murder. Intent on proving the so-called psychic is a fraud -- as well as a killer -- Jane arranges a séance to expose the murderer.

videos.title: The Thin Red Line
videos.overview: While the police suspect a drug dealer on trial is behind the murders of the State's witness in his case, as well as his girlfriend, Patrick Jane sees a different motive for the crime -- as well as a different suspect.

videos.title: Flame Red
videos.overview: Patrick Jane suspects the only surviving member of a National Guard unit of murdering his friends - and goes undercover to prove it.

videos.title: Red Brick and Ivy
videos.overview: When a leading scientific researcher is killed by poisoning, Patrick Jane takes a personal interest in the case when he learns the prime suspect is the victim's wife - and Jane's former psychiatrist.

videos.title: Red John's Friends
videos.overview: Enticed by the promise from a convicted murder that he'll reveal information about Red John upon his release, Patrick Jane becomes singularly focused and quits the CBI in order to prove the prisoner is innocent.

videos.title: Red Rum
videos.overview: Patrick Jane sets a mentalist trap to find out who is responsible for the murder of a high school boy who antagonized the local self-proclaimed witch by killing her cat.

videos.title: Paint It Red
videos.overview: While it appears obvious that a business tycoon's son-in-law was in on the robbery of a $50 million painting since his body is found where the painting once hung, Patrick Jane suspects others, including a Russian oil baron, an art forger and an art curator.

videos.title: Crimson Casanova
videos.overview: With Patrick Jane's help, Cho goes undercover as a sweet-talking ladies man with all the right moves in order to catch a pick-up artist and killer with his own set of pseudo-mentalist techniques.

videos.title: Scarlett Fever
videos.overview: As Jane and the team investigate the poisoning death of the "queen bee" in a country club, they discover that the community is full of secrets, including love affairs and drug abuse

videos.title: Bloodshot
videos.overview: Patrick Jane must rely on his other senses during the murder investigation of a financial advisor when he loses his sight as a result of an explosion.

videos.title: Carnelian Inc.
videos.overview: A story of greed and betrayal pits Patrick Jane against a group of financiers when the CBI investigates a series of murders at a corporate retreat in the wilds of the Sierra Nevada foothills.

videos.title: Russet Potatoes
videos.overview: Patrick Jane and the CBI team track down a mastermind who hypnotizes people into doing their bidding.

videos.title: A Dozen Red Roses
videos.overview: Patrick Jane and the team go to Hollywood when they investigate the murder of a movie producer.

videos.title: Red Sauce
videos.overview: Patrick Jane and the CBI team investigate the murder of a mobster who was in the witness protection program.

videos.title: Miss Red
videos.overview: Patrick Jane uses his mentalist skills to play suspects off each other in order to solve the case of a wealthy software company CEO found murdered on his yacht.

videos.title: Blood Brothers
videos.overview: Patrick Jane must find a clever way to convince the troubled kids in a wilderness program to confide in him about what really happened surrounding the death of one of their peers.

videos.title: Red John's Footsteps
videos.overview: Lisbon fears that the serial killer Red John is drawing Patrick Jane into a trap when the CBI team investigates the murder of a young girl and the abduction of her twin sister.

videos.title: Redemption
videos.overview: Jane and Lisbon learn that the Red John case has been reassigned to a different CBI team led by the straight-shooting officer Sam Bosco.

videos.title: The Scarlet Letter
videos.overview: Lisbon and the team work the case of a State Senator's murdered intern, while Jane simultaneously tries to find out what new information Bosco has uncovered on the Red John case.

videos.title: Red Badge
videos.overview: Jane, Cho, Rigsby and Van Pelt decide to conduct their own investigation when Lisbon is accused of murdering a child molester she arrested who was recently paroled.

videos.title: Red Menace
videos.overview: Jane and the CBI investigate the murder of Gordon Hodge, a powerful attorney, who is responsible for allowing a vicious murderer, Van McBride, to walk away a free man.

videos.title: Red Scare
videos.overview: Jane and the CBI team are called in to investigate the death of a prominent architect found murdered in a crumbling old mansion, and there appears to be a number of suspects.

videos.title: Black Gold and Red Blood
videos.overview: Even after Bosco arrests Jane and puts him in prison for spying on him, Jane is able to help the CBI team from his cell to solve the murder of a young man.

videos.title: Red Bulls
videos.overview: Minelli orders Patrick Jane and Lisbon and company to play nice and work together with Bosco and his team to locate a kidnapped woman being held for ransom.

videos.title: His Red Right Hand
videos.overview: The CBI team is faced with a violent and shocking crime in their own office, but must work the case in spite of their alarm of who may be behind it. Meanwhile, Rigsby and Van Pelt are definitely an "item".

videos.title: A Price Above Rubies
videos.overview: Patrick Jane and the team are called to investigate the robbery and murder of a wealthy jeweler while attending a black tie fundraiser for the CBI.

videos.title: Throwing Fire
videos.overview: While Jane and the team examine the crime scene where a baseball scout is found murdered, Jane is clocked in the head by a ball and flashes back to his childhood with his overbearing father.

videos.title: Rose-Colored Glasses
videos.overview: Jane and company investigate the murder of a man and his wife, on her way to his fifteen year high school reunion where, clearly, the attendees haven't changed all that much.

videos.title: Bleeding Heart
videos.overview: Patrick Jane and the team investigate the murder of a mayor's aide, and Rigsby and Van Pelt make a big announcement.

videos.title: Redline
videos.overview: Patrick Jane and the CBI team investigate when the body of a high-end luxury car sales woman is found in the trunk of a Bentley in the dealership's showroom.

videos.title: Blood In, Blood Out
videos.overview: When a member of Cho's former gang, the Avon Park Playboys, is found murdered, Patrick Jane insists on helping Cho with his off-the-books investigation.

videos.title: Red Herring
videos.overview: Jane and the team investigate the murder of an arrogant chef during a cooking competition in Napa Valley.

videos.title: Code Red
videos.overview: When Dr. Alicia Seberg, a government research scientist, is exposed to a deadly toxin while at work and has only hours to live, she calls Patrick Jane and the CBI to find her murderer.

videos.title: The Red Box
videos.overview: Patrick and the CBI team investigate the murder of a tutor, and find a mysterious little red box near the body, starting a chain of events that turns the murder into the search for a priceless ring stolen from the British Museum. Meanwhile, Lisbon is worried when a new boss, Madeleine Hightower, takes command of the CBI, as well as mysteriously learning about Rigsby and Van Pelt's relationship.

videos.title: Aingavite Baa
videos.overview: When a "Jane Doe" with amnesia and covered in blood steps in front of Cho and Van Pelt's car, Patrick Jane must use all of his skills to discover who she is, her last location and why she lost her memory

videos.title: Blood Money
videos.overview: When Patrick Jane's sneaky conduct causes the case of a confessed hitman to be tossed out of court, his annoyed CBI team must start the investigation over from scratch.

videos.title: Red All Over
videos.overview: When a media mogul is murdered, Patrick Jane and the CBI team investigate cult leader Bret Stiles, who may have had an axe to grind following the publication of a critical story about his group.
Patrick Jane and the CBI team investigate the death of a mathematical genius by a gun-wielding clown.

videos.title: Red Letter
videos.overview: Romantic sparks begin to fly when Patrick Jane and supposed psychic Kristina Frye cross paths again during the CBI investigation into the murder of a charismatic head of a non-profit organization that fights human trafficking.

videos.title: Red Sky in the Morning
videos.overview: Patrick Jane and Kristina's first date is interrupted by a report of Red John striking again, which is discovered to be a copycat. But when Kristina reaches out to the real Red John, both she and Jane find themselves in grave danger.

videos.title: Red Sky at Night
videos.overview: When the CBI investigates the kidnapping of a prominent lawyer and state house lobbyist, the CBI Director wants Jane on the case, but he is uncertain of his future with the unit after his encounter with Red John.

videos.title: Cackle-Bladder Blood
videos.overview: When Jane's brother-in-law returns to town and gets mixed up in a murder investigation, Jane must come to his aid despite personal reservations.

videos.title: The Blood on His Hands
videos.overview: When Patrick Jane faces off once again with cult leader Bret Stiles, Stiles offers Jane information regarding Red John and the missing Kristina Frye.

videos.title: Red Carpet Treatment
videos.overview: Patrick Jane and the CBI team are called in to investigate the murder of a convict who served nine years for rape and murder, but was recently released on DNA evidence.

videos.title: The Red Ponies
videos.overview: Patrick Jane and the CBI team hit the horse track when a jockey is found murdered and suspects abound.

videos.title: Pink Chanel Suit
videos.overview: The case of a murder and missing person on an intensely secure wealthy family's compound perplexes Jane and the CBI team.

videos.title: Red Hot
videos.overview: Jane and the CBI team narrowly escape a fiery end when a building explodes while they're investigating a death threat. Meanwhile, sparks fly between Lisbon and billionaire Walter Mashburn when they meet again while on the case.

videos.title: Ball of Fire
videos.overview: When Jane is kidnapped, Lisbon and the team realize there are many suspects who might want to harm him.

videos.title: Red Moon
videos.overview: Patrick Jane accepts the help of a local astrologer, Ellis Mars, to solve the puzzling case of a triple homicide that involves two policemen and the fiancé of an EMT worker.

videos.title: Jolly Red Elf
videos.overview: The CBI pursues two lines of investigation when a Santa is murdered: Patrick Jane goes undercover in an AA group; and Rigsby and Van Pelt question members of an authentic Santa society. Meanwhile, following the demise of a person in custody at the CBI, J.J. LaRoche is brought in to question the team when it appears to be an inside job.

videos.title: Bloodsport
videos.overview: Patrick and the team investigate the murder of a woman with ties to one of the fighters. Meanwhile, LaRoche focuses his investigation on Rigsby, who in turn is forced to ask Cho for a huge favor in order to keep his job.

videos.title: Bloodhounds
videos.overview: When Patrick Jane and the CBI must work with a criminal profiler, Dr. Montague, to solve a double murder, it becomes a competition for Jane to prove that his methods are superior.

videos.title: Red Alert
videos.overview: When Patrick Jane and others are taken hostage by an armed man accused of murder, Jane must think quickly to defuse the situation.

videos.title: Blood for Blood
videos.overview: Van Pelt's actions are called into question when a witness is murdered while she is assigned to his protection.

videos.title: Red Gold
videos.overview: When a modern-day prospector is found dead near a mining site and Lisbon is injured during the initial stages of the investigation, Agent Hightower joins Patrick Jane in the field for the first time.

videos.title: Red Queen
videos.overview: Evidence in the murder of an antiques dealer found dead in a museum indicates that the suspect may be a member of the CBI team.

videos.title: Bloodstream
videos.overview: After a doctor is found dead at a golf course, the CBI team searches for a killer amongst a hospital's staff and patients. Meanwhile, when LaRoche is placed in charge of the CBI, his first act of business is to name Cho the new team leader.

videos.title: The Red Mile
videos.overview: Patrick Jane and the CBI team must track down the killer of a man who believed he experienced an alien abduction - even after the victim's body is stolen from the coroner's van. Meanwhile, Van Pelt takes a break from the case to shop for wedding dresses.

videos.title: Every Rose Has Its Thorn
videos.overview: Patrick Jane sets out to prove a beautiful yet manipulative matchmaker shot and killed her husband after his body is found floating in the marina.

videos.title: Redacted
videos.overview: Patrick Jane must deal with two failed robbery attempts: one resulting in the murder of a repair shop owner and the other involving a former suspect personally hired by Jane to break into LaRoche's home.

videos.title: Like a Redheaded Stepchild
videos.overview: When a prison guard is stabbed to death outside of a jewelry store, Patrick Jane suspects one of the guard's inmates is the killer. Meanwhile, Rigsby questions his own father about the murder.

videos.title: Rhapsody in Red
videos.overview: After a young violinist is shot to death, Patrick Jane questions the members of the Northern California Symphony Orchestra about the murder. Meanwhile, Cho crosses paths with a precocious young pickpocket.

videos.title: Strawberries and Cream (1)
videos.overview: A robber with a bomb attached to him is blown up in front of a convenience store, and CBI soon discovers that there may be connections between this case and Red John and agent Hightower.

videos.title: Strawberries and Cream (2)
videos.overview: Patrick trades Hightower's secret location to Laroche for the four remaining names on his list. The team then sets up a trap to uncover Red John's real informant, leading to a possible face-to-face showdown between Patrick and Red John.

videos.title: Scarlet Ribbons
videos.overview: In prison for killing his nemesis, Patrick Jane must prove that the man he shot really was Red John. Meanwhile, Lisbon urges Van Pelt to seek counseling in the aftermath of the death of her fiancé.

videos.title: Little Red Book
videos.overview: With Lisbon suspended and the rest of the team reassigned, Jane is reinstated as a CBI consultant and forced to work with a new team. During the investigation, Jane conspires to bring his former team back together.

videos.title: Pretty Red Balloon
videos.overview: When the son of a former client from Jane's days as a psychic is kidnapped, Jane and the CBI team are asked to help find him. Meanwhile, Jane butts heads with his former client's new "spiritual advisor."

videos.title: Ring Around the Rosie
videos.overview: Jane notices a suspicious-looking man carrying a gun at a political rally and sets out to prove he's a psychopath on the brink of committing murder. Meanwhile, Lisbon investigates the death of a photographer at the same rally.

videos.title: Blood and Sand
videos.overview: The CBI team investigates the murder of a woman whose corpse washed up on an island off the coast of California. Rigsby worries that his relationship with a public defender will create awkwardness between him and Van Pelt.

videos.title: Where in the World Is Carmine O'Brien?
videos.overview: When the CBI team travels to a resort town to find out who murdered a police chief, Lisbon crosses paths with her brother Tommy, now a bounty hunter, who's tracking a bail jumper.

videos.title: Blinking Red Light
videos.overview: The search for a serial killer hits close to home for Jane when he encounters a blogger who has devoted his life to finding the killer.

videos.title: Pink Tops
videos.overview: In order to find the killer of an undercover narcotics cop, Jane and the CBI team retrace her investigation.

videos.title: The Redshirt
videos.overview: Jane and the CBI investigate when a retired NFL star quarterback is presumed dead after his car blows up. Meanwhile, while preparing for a court case, Rigsby and Harrigan take their relationship to the next level.

videos.title: Fugue in Red
videos.overview: During the search for a firefighter's killer, Jane is attacked and nearly drowned, resulting in a temporary loss of his memory and a return to his pre-CBI con man persona.

videos.title: Always Bet on Red
videos.overview: Jane and the CBI team narrow down the long list of suspects after a high-end divorce attorney, with many enemies, is killed on his speed boat. Meanwhile, Jane is questioned by Agent Darcy about whether Red John was responsible for Panzer's murder.

videos.title: My Bloody Valentine
videos.overview: With very little evidence, Jane and the CBI investigate the death of a mob boss’ son. Meanwhile, while taking an eyewitness in for questioning, Van Pelt is haunted by the memories of O’Laughlin’s shooting.

videos.title: Red Is the New Black
videos.overview: Jane and the CBI narrow down the list of suspects after a disgraced clothing designer on the verge of a comeback becomes a fashion victim. Meanwhile, FBI Agent Darcy continues her investigation into finding Red John.

videos.title: At First Blush
videos.overview: While a jury deliberates the guilt or innocence of a defendant on trial for murder, Jane tries to prove she has been wrongfully accused before time runs out. Meanwhile, Summer may have gone too far when she helps Cho make a case against a suspect.

videos.title: War of the Roses
videos.overview: When a charity worker is killed, Jane has Erica Flynn, a murderer he helped imprison, furloughed in exchange for information she claims to have about the case. Meanwhile, Rigsby and Sarah try to adjust to impending parenthood.

videos.title: His Thoughts Were Red Thoughts
videos.overview: Jane is reunited with his former nemesis, cult leader Bret Stiles, when the head of an anti-cult activist organization is murdered.

videos.title: Cheap Burgundy
videos.overview: Jane suspects that Agent Susan Darcy has ulterior motives when she asks for his help with a homicide investigation. Meanwhile, the CBI team handles the murder of a young woman who was killed after meeting someone in an online chat room.

videos.title: Ruddy Cheeks
videos.overview: Jane and the CBI try to narrow down the list of suspects when a terminally ill man, is found murdered. Meanwhile, Cho is forced to face his demons.

videos.title: Pink Champagne on Ice
videos.overview: While investigating the murder of a casino employee, Jane runs into a stage magician he used to tour with during his time as a mentalist and discovers he is hiding a shocking secret.

videos.title: Something's Rotten in Redmund
videos.overview: Jane and the CBI try to determine who would have reason to kill a popular English teacher, and Rigsby nervously awaits a special delivery.

videos.title: Ruby Slippers
videos.overview: Jane and the CBI try to find the killer of a man found outside a cabaret featuring female impersonators. During the investigation they discover a list of suspects, all of whom bullied the victim. Meanwhile, Cho and Summer hide their relationship from Lisbon.

videos.title: So Long, and Thanks for All the Red Snapper
videos.overview: While investigating the murder of a surfer, Lisbon reconnects with her former fiancé, Kenny Johnson, who she hasn't seen in over a decade. Also, Cho questions his decision to be in a relationship with Summer.

videos.title: Red Rover, Red Rover
videos.overview: On the ninth anniversary of his wife and daughter's death, Jane receives a message from Red John, causing Jane to lose focus on his current case and put the investigation and his career at the CBI in jeopardy

videos.title: The Crimson Hat
videos.overview: After another failed attempt to defeat Red John, Patrick Jane hits rock bottom, finds a lover and shoots one of his own.

videos.title: The Crimson Ticket
videos.overview: While Jane tries to decipher Lorelei’s connection to Red John, the CBI team is forced to partner with the FBI to solve the murder of a hotel employee.

videos.title: Devil's Cherry
videos.overview: While the team investigates the murder of a diamond cutter, Jane meets a girl who claims to be his late daughter, Charlotte.

videos.title: Not One Red Cent
videos.overview: A bank employee is murdered during a heist and Jane and the team must work to track down the killer. Meanwhile, Lisbon is pulled deeper into the CBI/FBI rivalry.

videos.title: Blood Feud
videos.overview: When Rigsby’s father is found injured at a crime scene, the team must find out if it is the result of a long-standing small-town gang war.

videos.title: Red Dawn
videos.overview: See how Jane met Lisbon and the rest of the CBI team for the first time.

videos.title: Cherry Picked
videos.overview: The team investigates the kidnapping of a couple that may be the victim of mistaken identity, while Jane continues his investigation into Lorelei's whereabouts.

videos.title: If It Bleeds, It Leads
videos.overview: The team investigates the murder of a reporter who may have become too close to her story, while Jane insists on pursuing his own leads to find Lorelei.

videos.title: Red Sails in the Sunset
videos.overview: With the help of Brett Stiles, Jane orchestrates an elaborate plan to break Lorelei Martins out of prison in the hopes of her leading him to Red John.

videos.title: Black Cherry
videos.overview: The CBI team investigates the murder of a real estate agent with former gang ties, while Jane searches for leads on his new connection to Red John.

videos.title: Panama Red
videos.overview: The death of a young botanist leads the team into the lucrative world of medical marijuana, while Cho’s work with the rapid response team brings him back into contact with Summer.

videos.title: Days of Wine and Roses
videos.overview: The CBI team visits a high-end California rehab center in order to investigate the death of a young model who was a patient there, while Lisbon ramps up her investigation into Tommy Volker.

videos.title: Little Red Corvette
videos.overview: The CBI investigates the death of a geologist, which Lisbon is convinced is the key to bringing down Tommy Volker.

videos.title: The Red Barn
videos.overview: The team investigates a 25-year-old case that seems to involve both Red John and the Visualize group, and Lisbon contemplates her future.

videos.title: Red in Tooth and Claw
videos.overview: The team delves into the surprisingly cutthroat world of academics in a case involving a graduate student at a natural history museum.

videos.title: Red Lacquer Nail Polish
videos.overview: Jane and the team investigate the murder of an elderly heiress whose remains are found in the living room of her spooky mansion.

videos.title: There Will Be Blood
videos.overview: Lorelei Martins returns, determined to find out if Red John had a role in her sister's death, and Jane is forced to confess to Lisbon his part in Lorelei's prison escape.

videos.title: Red, White and Blue
videos.overview: The CBI team investigates when the body of a female army medic who worked with soldiers with PTSD is found near a military base.

videos.title: Behind the Red Curtain
videos.overview: The CBI team investigates when the young lead of a local theater production dies on the eve of the opening. Meanwhile, Jane hopes to get more information about Red John from the comatose Jason Lennon.

videos.title: Red Letter Day
videos.overview: The CBI team heads out to a run-down Wild West tourist town to investigate the death of the town's owner. Meanwhile, Kirkland tries to uncover the extent of Jane's knowledge about Red John.

videos.title: Red Velvet Cupcakes
videos.overview: Rigsby and Van Pelt go undercover as a couple with relationship problems to investigate the death of a woman who received advice from a radio love doctor.

videos.title: Red and Itchy
videos.overview: J.J. LaRoche personally requests Jane’s help when the mysterious container he’s been hiding for nine years is stolen from his home.

videos.title: Red John's Rules
videos.overview: Just as Jane narrows down the Red John suspect list to seven, Red John strikes again, and the victim has a link to Jane’s past.

videos.title: The Desert Rose
videos.overview: Jane and Lisbon secretly continue their mission to narrow down the list of seven Red John suspects as they investigate the murder of a man who was missing for two years.

videos.title: Black-Winged Redbird
videos.overview: Jane discovers an important clue to Red John's methods as the team  encounters four of the suspects, and the CBI investigates the case of a  software engineer killed by a drone strike.

videos.title: Wedding in Red
videos.overview: Jane gets the CBI involved in a case in Napa in order to focus on Sheriff McAllister, while Van Pelt and Rigsby take a trip down the aisle.

videos.title: Red Listed
videos.overview: Jane reveals that a list of fake Red John suspects he planted was stolen, and the team realizes these men are in danger.

videos.title: The Red Tattoo
videos.overview: When a prominent member of Visualize is mysteriously killed, Jane investigates in the hopes that the case will provide a clue that will lead him to Red John.

videos.title: Fire and Brimstone
videos.overview: With the final clue in hand, Jane attempts to gather the remaining Red John suspects in one place in hopes of finally revealing his identity.

videos.title: The Great Red Dragon
videos.overview: Following the shocking events at Jane's house, the Red John list is  narrowed down further, and the CBI's priority is the remaining suspects.

videos.title: Red John
videos.overview: Patrick Jane finally comes face-to-face with Red John, the serial killer he’s tracked since the madman murdered his wife and daughter. For 10 years, Jane has doggedly hunted his nemesis in his search for justice.

videos.title: My Blue Heaven
videos.overview: Two years after the Red John case was  put to rest, Jane's newfound  peace is interrupted by a surprising job offer that could change  everything for him.

videos.title: Green Thumb
videos.overview: The FBI reluctantly enlists Jane’s help to find a missing computer programmer, but he won’t help unless Lisbon is brought on board as well.

videos.title: White Lines
videos.overview: The FBI is tasked with finding the killer of several DEA agents, and Jane goes on a date with a beautiful woman associated with the case.

videos.title: The Golden Hammer
videos.overview: Jane and the FBI investigate the murder of a high-tech cartographer who may have unearthed a spy ring before his death. Meanwhile, Rigsby and Van Pelt find themselves on the trail of an alarming conspiracy.

videos.title: Black Helicopters
videos.overview: Jane's investigation leads him to join a separatist commune after a U.S.  attorney is found dead in Mexico, even though there's no record of her  crossing  the border.  Also, Rigsby and Van Pelt convince J.J. LaRoche to  help them discover who is stalking former CBI members.

videos.title: Grey Water
videos.overview: Jane and Fischer investigate a murder at an oil fracking site, while Rigsby and Van Pelt travel to Austin to help investigate suspects in the string of attacks on former CBI team members.

videos.title: White as the Driven Snow
videos.overview: Grace is kidnapped by the killer who has been hunting former CBI members, but when the prime suspect appears to have an airtight alibi, Jane must rely on all his skills to locate her before time runs out.

videos.title: Violets
videos.overview: Jane enlists his colleagues in a dangerous sting operation to catch a deadly team of art thieves. Meanwhile, sparks fly between Lisbon and an agent from the FBI’s art squad.

videos.title: Silver Wings of Time
videos.overview: Jane and the FBI take up the cause of a death row inmate who has two days to prove his innocence before his sentence is carried out.

videos.title: Forest Green
videos.overview: When a woman is found murdered near a remote men’s social club, Jane must find a way to insinuate himself into the insular group to find the killer.

videos.title: Brown Eyed Girls
videos.overview: A chance encounter with a suspicious-looking individual leads Jane and Lisbon to uncover a vast human smuggling ring. Meanwhile, Lisbon remains tempted by Pike’s offer to move to D.C. with him.

videos.title: Il Tavolo Bianco
videos.overview: Jane’s freedom is at stake when a grand jury is empanelled to decide if he should be tried for the murder of Red John. Meanwhile, Lisbon tries to find out how Jane feels about the possibility of her leaving Austin with Agent Pike, and Cho and Abbott follow new leads in the human smuggling ring they recently uncovered.

videos.title: Black Hearts
videos.overview: With time running out to save the victims of a kidnapping ring before they are transported overseas, Jane and Lisbon zero in on the criminal enterprise’s mastermind. Meanwhile, Lisbon decides if she will move to D.C. with Agent Pike.

videos.title: Blue Bird
videos.overview: A new lead in a cold case requires Lisbon to delay her plans to leave for Washington, D.C., giving Jane time to finally come to terms with his feelings for her and decide on a course of action.

videos.title: Nothing But Blue Skies
videos.overview: Jane and Lisbon decide to keep their new relationship a secret from  their colleagues as they investigate the murder of an undercover agent.  Also, young, ambitious agent Michelle Vega joins the team.

videos.title: The Greybar Hotel
videos.overview: Lisbon goes undercover as a prison inmate in order to get a convict to turn on her boyfriend, who is the leader of a high-end car theft ring.

videos.title: Orange Blossom Ice Cream
videos.overview: Jane and Lisbon travel to Beirut where they must work with Jane's familiar adversary Erica Flynn, who agrees to help the FBI apprehend her boyfriend, a courier for terrorist organizations, in exchange for amnesty for her past crimes.

videos.title: Black Market
videos.overview: The team investigates a murder linked to a counterfeit diamond operation, but an illness forces Jane to direct his colleagues from the office as he recuperates. Meanwhile, Abbott is concerned that transgressions in his past could harm his wife’s chance to obtain a prestigious job in Washington, D.C.

videos.title: The Silver Briefcase
videos.overview: A chance encounter with a military colonel leads Jane to believe the soldier is hiding something, leading him to dig into closed murder case of the man’s wife.

videos.title: Green Light
videos.overview: The team is brought in to consult on a botched DEA raid, but when Abbott’s former boss tries to blackmail him into keeping the agency’s missteps quiet, Abbott is forced to choose between his career and his morals.

videos.title: Little Yellow House
videos.overview: A murder investigation becomes personal for Lisbon when she learns that her underachieving younger brother, Jimmy, is being sought as a key witness.

videos.title: The Whites of His Eyes
videos.overview: Jane worries for Lisbon’s safety when the team puts itself in the line of fire to protect the witness in a murder investigation from a skilled assassin.

videos.title: Copper Bullet
videos.overview: When Abbott's old boss, Agent Peterson, threatens Abbott's career - and possibly his freedom - Jane devises a risky plan to protect his friend's  future.

videos.title: Nothing Gold Can Stay
videos.overview: Jane takes extreme measures as the team tries to apprehend a deadly gang of armored car robbers before their desperation to remain free costs more innocent people their lives.

videos.title: Byzantium
videos.overview: A young man claiming to have psychic powers offers his help to the FBI in solving a pair of murders, but when he leads them to additional victims, Jane and the team begin to suspect that he is in fact the killer they're hunting.

videos.title: Brown Shag Carpet
videos.overview: Jane agrees to once again pretend to be a renowned psychic and be used as bait in an attempt to lure out a serial killer and give the FBI a chance to apprehend him.

videos.title: White Orchids
videos.overview: Lisbon accepts Jane's surprise marriage proposal, but a killer's quest for revenge may cost them the happy ending they've worked so hard to achieve.
